summary: MPI partitions rows and CSR intervals; each rank further partitions by nonzero count across its GPU contexts and rebases row pointers. An OpenMP worker per GPU owns that context and timed runtime loop launches each GPU's selected group-size kernel for every repetition, synchronizes and records output. The selector dispatches groups 2/4/8/16/32; all five final SASS specializations are included, each with row/nonzero control, reduction and output store.

source_evidence.claim: Balanced MPI/device row partition, selected group kernel, per-device OpenMP timed loop and full result collection.

compiled_evidence.claim: Clock boundary and persistent outlined worker execute GPU arithmetic path; all five device stub targets exist in the same executable.
